hero.name: Himasara Ratnakumara
hero.intro: I craft dynamic, beautiful, and highly functional web applications. Bringing ideas to life through elegant code and stunning design.

about.text1: I am a passionate Web Developer and UI/UX Designer based in Sri Lanka. I specialize in building modern, responsive, and performance-optimized websites that provide an amazing user experience.
about.text2: With a strong foundation in both frontend and backend technologies, I bridge the gap between stunning visual design and robust technical implementation.
about.career_goal: To constantly push the boundaries of web design and development, creating digital experiences that leave a lasting impact while expanding my expertise in modern frameworks.
